sections.heading: Visit and planned services
body: This letter summarizes the services planned for your visit in plain terms, as discussed with your provider.

sections.heading: Payer-stated benefits
body: The figures below reflect what the payer stated on the verification date noted. They are not a promise of payment.

sections.heading: Required estimate notice
body: All figures in this letter are estimates only. Estimates are not guarantees of coverage, payment, or patient responsibility. The payer makes the final determination under the plan terms in effect on the date of service. Other claims, eligibility changes, or pre-determination outcomes can change the final amount.

sections.heading: Opening and identifiers
body: Introduce the practice and role, state the scheduled visit date as the date of service, and provide subscriber identifiers and group number.

sections.heading: Questions to ask verbatim
body: Ask eligibility on the date of service, class benefits and maximum with used and remaining, waiting periods, frequency limits per planned group, missing-tooth and downgrade rules, coordination order for dual coverage, and preauthorization per planned code. Read back figures and request a reference number.

sections.heading: Claim and denial details
body: Record the claim reference, verification identifier, denial code and text, and the mapped verification point.

sections.heading: Corrective action
body: State the corrective action, owner, and status so the same gap does not repeat.

sections.heading: Hold items
body: List each incomplete verification with the missing point, impact, and disposition.
